draft.summary: Based on our evaluation of approved alternatives to bookyourdata.

sections.heading: Summary
sections.body: Approved alternatives (4) with relationship reasons — not a random category list.

sections.heading: Alternatives
sections.body:
apollo: relevant because Apollo bundles contact data with sequencing — better when you want one subscription for lists and outreach instead of pay-as-you-go credits alone; better when that tradeoff fits; worse when the source product's strengths matter more.
lusha: relevant because Lusha is a stronger fit when you need ongoing CRM enrichment and signals rather than one-shot verified list buys; better when that tradeoff fits; worse when the source product's strengths matter more.
rocketreach: relevant because RocketReach publishes individual credit-plan cards — better when transparent seat/credit pricing matters more than pay-as-you-go packs; better when that tradeoff fits; worse when the source product's strengths matter more.
amplemarket: relevant because Amplemarket is the better substitute when AI outbound execution matters more than buying verified contact packs; better when that tradeoff fits; worse when the source product's strengths matter more.

sections.heading: Decision guidance
sections.body: Use comparison pages for pairwise decisions; do not invent superiority.

faq.question: Is this alternatives page based on live vendor verification?
faq.answer: Only approved or verified facts and pricing-engine outputs in the brief may be cited. Unverified research is not treated as live vendor truth.

faq.question: Has SoftwareGlimpse personally tested bookyourdata?
faq.answer: No. This draft is based on our evaluation of research evidence, not personal product usage.
